name: Tooltip
description: Small contextual hint shown on hover/focus of its trigger, positioned above or below.
notes: bubble (slot 'bubble', overlay on trigger): type text, content '{content}', style --text-caption, color --tooltip-text, on a box background --tooltip-bg radius --radius-tooltip padding 6px/10px (6px is off the --space scale, nearest is --space-xxs=2 or --space-sm=8 — kept as raw numbers per source since not authored as a token) with --elevation-overlay shadow; hidden until hover/focus.
